Cases
* Val aeiou: The input string has already been used in another test. Please use another string that contains both consonants and vowels, similar to "hello".

* Val aaa: Please use another string that contains both consonants and vowels, similar to "programming".

* Val bcdfghjklmnpqrstvwxyz: Please use another string that consists of multiple vowels only, similar to "aeiou".

* Please create a new pair of cases with the test and the validator covering all the letters not yet included in other tests and validators, respectively. The letters should be ordered in a random order, and some of them appear more than once.

Thanks.

Goal
* Please change "Print" back to "Output".

Cases
* Please create a new pair of cases that contain the specified letters in a random order, with each letter appearing more than once:

  • Test 7: cdfjkqstvwaeiou

  • Validator 7: bcfgjkpqtvxaeiou

Thanks.

Cases
* Please revise Test 7 and Validator 7.

  • Test 7 contains these letters: cdfjkqstvwaeiou.

  • Validator 7 contains these letters: bcfgjkpqtvxaeiou.

  • In both cases, each letter should appear more than once.

  • In both cases, the letters should appear in a random order.

  • Test 7 and Validator 7 should expect different outputs.

Thanks.
